faq.title: FAQs
faq.description: Frequently asked questions about WebCreativeTeam services, process and collaboration.
headline: You have questions
We have answers
faq.lead: Find quick, clear answers about our process, services, timelines and collaboration.

questions.question: What services does WebCreativeTeam offer?
questions.answer: We create and improve websites, help customers find you more easily on Google and AI search engines, build recognizable brands, and plan effective advertising campaigns. We also offer AI solutions that automate repetitive tasks and save time. We take care of technical maintenance and website performance so you can focus on your business.

questions.question: How much does it cost?
questions.answer: The price depends on the type of service and the project's complexity and scope. We prepare individual proposals tailored to specific needs and budgets. After discussing the requirements, we provide an offer with clear activities and costs.

questions.question: How does a new project begin?
questions.answer: After speaking with you, we clarify the requirements, discuss your business ideas and goals, consider possible solutions, and define the scope of work. We then prepare a proposal with specific activities, a quote, and a delivery schedule.

questions.question: A new website or a redesign of the old one?
questions.answer: You do not always need to start from scratch. After assessing the design, functionality, technical condition, and how well your existing website is optimized, we will recommend a redesign, optimization, an upgrade, or an entirely new build.

questions.question: Can I request just one service?
questions.answer: Yes. You can request a specific service, such as SEO optimization, ad management, branding, or website development. When appropriate, we also suggest combined solutions that bring different digital services together.

questions.question: What is the difference between SEO and GEO?
questions.answer: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) improves a website's visibility in popular search engines. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) aims to help AI search engines and generative systems find and use content. Both approaches are important and complement each other in helping customers find you more easily.

questions.question: How will AI automation for business help me?
questions.answer: AI automation reduces repetitive and time-consuming tasks, makes information easier to process, and connects different systems. We develop AI assistants and automated workflows that save time and free teams to focus on more important work.

questions.question: Do you offer website maintenance?
questions.answer: Yes. We provide technical maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, optimization, and improvements to existing websites. The aim is to keep the website reliable, up to date, and functional as the business's needs change.

questions.question: How are marketing results measured?
questions.answer: We use metrics that match the project's goals, such as visits, enquiries, conversions, advertising costs, and engagement. We analyze the data, assess performance, and identify opportunities to improve digital campaigns.

questions.question: Why is my website not attracting customers?
questions.answer: Possible reasons include poor visibility in Google and AI search engines, unsuitable content, technical issues, weak performance, or a poor user experience. We analyze the website and recommend SEO, GEO, marketing, and technical improvements based on the issues we find.

questions.question: What does a project proposal include?
questions.answer: The proposal describes the recommended solution, main activities, project scope, estimated timelines, and price. When needed, we also specify individual phases, integrations, and options for ongoing support.

questions.question: Is a first-place ranking in Google guaranteed?
questions.answer: No SEO agency can guarantee a specific position in Google or inclusion in AI-generated answers. However, by improving technical optimization, content, and performance, online visibility will certainly increase. We assess all this through measurable indicators that show actual results.

questions.question: Why choose WebCreativeTeam?
questions.answer:
Because we look at your business as a whole, rather than a series of separate tasks. First, we work to understand what you want to achieve, then we suggest solutions that will actually help you.

We combine digital marketing, SEO & GEO, AI automation, branding, and web development with professional QA testing and technical support. This lets us support both your online visibility and performance, as well as the quality and reliable operation of your website.

We speak plainly, pay attention to detail, and do not recommend services you do not need. For us, the best solution is not necessarily the most complex one, but the one that brings real value to your business.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How WebCreativeTeam handles personal data from enquiries, site visits and administration access.
privacy.contactLead: For questions about your personal data, email
privacy.complaintLink: Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection

sections.heading: What do we collect and why?
paragraphs: When you send an enquiry, we receive your name, email address and message. You may also provide a phone number, website, budget, services of interest and a newsletter subscription request. We use this information to respond and discuss possible services. Our legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering a contract (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)) or our legitimate interest in responding to other enquiries (Article 6(1)(f)).
Name, email and message are required for the form. You must also acknowledge that you have read this policy and pass the security check. Other fields are optional. You may email us directly instead.

If you select newsletter consent, submitting the enquiry also requests a subscription for the email provided. This is separate from the enquiry and requires confirmation through an email sent to you. The checkbox is optional.

sections.heading: Newsletter subscriptions
paragraphs: Subscribing is optional. We use your explicit consent (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)), confirmed through an email link, to send news and useful content. Declining or not confirming within 30 days deletes the pending request. You can unsubscribe through a link in the email or contact us at the email address above.

After unsubscribing, we stop newsletter mail and keep a limited record of the previous subscription for up to three years from unsubscribe, to determine whether the address has already used any future promotion for new subscribers. We rely on our legitimate interest for this separate purpose (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)). You may object and request erasure. A new request during this period does not extend it; fresh confirmation activates the subscription again. Subscriber data is stored in MongoDB Atlas and email is delivered through Google/Gmail.

sections.heading: How do we protect the site?
paragraphs: Visits and form submissions involve technical data, such as IP address and browser information, to operate and protect the site. Contact and newsletter forms use Google reCAPTCHA to prevent automated abuse. Our basis is the legitimate interest in providing a secure service (Article 6(1)(f)). reCAPTCHA loads when you start submitting the form; if the check fails, you can email us instead.
We do not use solely automated decisions about providing services that have legal or similarly significant effects on you.

sections.heading: Who receives the data and how long do we keep it?
paragraphs: Enquiries arrive in our business mailbox and are accessible to team members who answer them. We use Render for hosting, Google/Gmail for email and reCAPTCHA, and MongoDB Atlas for administrative access and subscriptions. We do not sell personal data.

We keep enquiries for 12 months after the last contact, unless a legal obligation or defence of a claim requires longer. For administrator accounts, we process work email, username, sign-in and access-recovery data to manage and protect the site, based on our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f)). An account is kept until it is deleted; security audit records are kept for up to 90 days. Technical records are kept as needed for security and under the applicable providers' retention schedules.

Our providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where an international transfer applies, we use a mechanism permitted under the GDPR, such as an adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses. You can request information about the applicable safeguards by email.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: This site uses a necessary cookie to remember your cookie choice. If you accept all cookies, we remember the language of the last page you viewed for up to 30 days. The administration area uses a separate sign-in cookie for up to 2 days. Google reCAPTCHA may use browser storage when you submit the contact or newsletter form. We do not use our own advertising or analytics cookies. You can find details and change your choice in the Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, erasure or restriction of your personal data and, where applicable, portability. You may object at any time to processing based on legitimate interests. Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it without affecting earlier lawful processing.
Contact us at the email address above. We will reply within one month, extendable by two months for complex requests, and notify you of any extension.

cookies.description: The cookies WebCreativeTeam uses and how you can change your choice.
cookies.summary: Necessary cookies remember your choice and protect administration sign-in. If you accept all cookies, we will remember the language of the last page you viewed for 30 days. We do not use our own advertising or analytics cookies.
cookies.necessaryNote: Strictly necessary cookies remain active with every choice. “Reject all cookies” and “Accept necessary cookies only” have the same effect. Closing this dialog also means necessary cookies only.
cookies.purpose: Cookies are small records stored in your browser. A necessary record remembers your cookie choice. If you sign in to the administration area, a separate cookie keeps your session secure. These records are not used for advertising.
cookies.language: If you choose “Accept all cookies”, we remember the language of the last page you viewed for up to 30 days from your last visit. The other two choices turn off this preference. You can still browse and switch languages; if you later open an address without a language, you will see the Bulgarian version.
